newsitem.title: UK: Robert Walters up on positive comment.
newsitem.headline: Robert Walters up on positive comment.

text.p: Shares in recruitment agency Robert Walters Plc rose on Monday after upbeat comment about the stock in the Sunday Times.
Robert Walters shares were up 12-1/2p at 233-1/2 by 0916 GMT in volume of 81,746 shares.

The Sunday Times' Inside Track column noted that analysts had recently substantially raised their profit forecasts for the coming year and said the company was well placed to benefit from growth in its key markets.
The column said the stock was trading on a multiple of around 14 times prospective 1998 earnings, which it argued was too low for such a fast-growing company.
